title: feat: add Kokoro TTS through DeepInfra
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds paid-only `kokoro` TTS through DeepInfra's exact `hexgrad/Kokoro-82M` route with multiplier 1, no fallback, and no Pollinations GPU.
- Supports 54 voices and MP3, Opus, FLAC, WAV, and PCM through `/audio/{text}` and `/v1/audio/speech`.
- Reuses the existing DeepInfra TTS adapter and bills Unicode code points at DeepInfra's posted $0.62 per million input characters.
- Adds the Hexgrad brand asset and aliases `kokoro-82m`, `kokoro-tts`, and `hexgrad-kokoro-82m`.

Validation:
- DeepInfra direct: 54/54 voices and all five formats passed.
- Local E2E: GET and POST, 54/54 voices, all formats, cache behavior, billing, authentication, and invalid inputs passed.
- Gen: typecheck and 798 tests passed.
- Enter: typecheck, 286 alias tests, and effective-pricing snapshot passed.

Draft for maintainer validation before merge.

Fixes #10994

gist.headline: Kokoro joins the chorus
gist.blurb: The hive picked up Kokoro TTS through DeepInfra. Bring text, choose from 54 voices, and leave with audio in the format your little project actually wants.
gist.summary: Added paid-only DeepInfra Kokoro TTS using the exact hexgrad/Kokoro-82M route, with 54 voices and MP3, Opus, FLAC, WAV, and PCM output on both /audio/{text} and /v1/audio/speech.
gist.impact: Developers can generate Kokoro speech through the existing audio endpoints in 54 validated voices and five formats, with billing based on Unicode code points at DeepInfra's posted $0.62 per million input characters.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy sound garden represents the new Kokoro TTS model: Polli wears tiny studio headphones and adjusts a retro microphone beside a DeepInfra-powered CRT audio console. Fifty-four small pastel sound-flower buds bloom around the console, while labeled cassette-like output icons suggest MP3, Opus, FLAC, WAV, and PCM; the Hexgrad mark appears subtly on a small sign.
